title: Men's Daily Greens Powder Comparison
author: Guys Goals
html:
How our Daily Greens + Reds compares to other top green powder blends.

 

Below we’ve put Guys Goals Men’s Daily Greens + Reds side-by-side with some of the most popular greens powders on the market. Each section includes a quick comparison table and a quick summary of how the formulas differ, with a focus on how well they fit men’s daily health, energy, and digestion.

 

Guys Goals Men’s Daily Greens + Reds vs Orgain Organic Superfoods + Probiotics

Feature / Detail Guys Goals Men’s Daily Greens + Reds Orgain Organic Superfoods + Probiotics
Serving Size / Servings 1 scoop (4.2 g) — 30 servings 1 scoop (~14 g) — ~20 servings
Core Greens ✔ Barley grass, wheat grass, broccoli, spirulina, green tea, alfalfa ✔ 50 organic “superfoods” including greens, grasses, veggies & sprouts
Reds / Fruits ✔ Beet, hibiscus, strawberry, cranberry, acai, blueberry, pomegranate ✔ Various fruits/berries inside 50-superfood blend (not individually dosed)
Metabolic / Adaptogen Support ✔ Cinnamon, turmeric, green tea, Panax ginseng, ashwagandha, black pepper ✘ Focus is on broad superfood blend; no clear adaptogen/metabolic stack
Digestive Support ✔ Inulin (prebiotic), ginger, sodium alginate ✔ ~7 g fiber + 1B CFU probiotics per serving
Probiotics ✘ None (pairs well with a separate probiotic) ✔ 1 billion CFU probiotics
Organic Certification ✔ 100% Natural
✔ Non-GMO
✘ Not USDA Organic 		✔ USDA Organic, plant-based, non-GMO
Positioning Men’s greens + reds with extra metabolic and digestive support. General superfood & digestion blend for broad daily use.
Approx. Price (tub) $12.99 (30 servings) ~$29.99 (20 servings)
Approx. Cost per Serving ~$0.43 per serving ~$1.50 per serving

High-level difference: Orgain delivers a big, organic superfood + probiotic combo for general wellness, with a larger scoop and higher price. Guys Goals is more targeted for men: greens + reds plus metabolic spices and adaptogens, with simple dosing and a much lower cost per serving.

So… which greens powder should you choose?

Looking across all these comparisons, a few themes show up pretty clearly:

  • Premium clinical or “all-in-one” greens (AG1, Green Vibrance, Greens+, Garden of Life) offer huge ingredient lists, probiotics, and complex blends — but you pay a premium of roughly $1.00–$3.00 per serving.
  • Mainstream greens (Orgain, Amazing Grass, Bloom) deliver solid everyday nutrition and brand recognition at mid-to-high price points, usually with probiotics and a general wellness focus.
  • Guys Goals Men’s Daily Greens + Reds is purposely simpler and more specific: it puts men’s daily needs first — greens, reds, metabolic support, and digestion support — at a price that doesn’t feel like a second gym membership.

Instead of trying to replace your multivitamin, probiotics, and half your supplement cabinet in one scoop, Men’s Daily Greens + Reds is designed to be a realistic daily add-on:

  • Greens for nutrient support (barley & wheat grass, broccoli, spirulina, green tea).
  • Reds for circulation and antioxidant support (beet, hibiscus, berries, pomegranate).
  • Metabolic and adaptogen support (cinnamon, turmeric, ginseng, ashwagandha, green tea, black pepper).
  • Digestive support (prebiotic inulin and ginger) to play well with whatever probiotic you prefer.
  • Simple 1-scoop dosing at about $0.43 per serving at the time of writing.

If you want the most clinical, all-in-one drink on earth and don’t mind paying several dollars a serving, some of the big-name greens brands make sense. If you just want the cheapest possible green powder, there are plenty of options for that too.

But if you’re a guy who wants:

  • A straightforward greens and reds blend;
  • Ingredients that actually nod to men’s real-world needs (energy, metabolism, digestion);
  • Something you can afford to take every day without overthinking it;

…that’s exactly the gap Guys Goals Men’s Daily Greens + Reds was built to fill.

Less money on supplements. More money for your actual goals.
